value: A full-scale aerospace wind-tunnel test bay at early morning, cobalt composite wing prototype on a measurement rig, steel gantry and pale mist, no other people

A fitted navy flight-test coverall with the sleeves rolled to the forearms, white technical harness belt, charcoal gloves clipped at the hip, and sturdy cobalt work boots; practical modern engineering wear
Full-body eye-level front three-quarter composition, her entire standing figure and both boots visible beside the wing test rig, cool dawn light crossed by one warm inspection lamp

She braces the blue wing prototype with her left hand while reading a handheld airflow probe in her right, caught mid-inspection with a calm confident expression. Preserve the SAME clearly adult Nordic woman from the attached Brave portrait: long narrow angular face, light skin, narrow upturned orange eyes, straight slender nose, thin lips, very tall lean long-limbed body, and long navy hair in a high ponytail with side-swept bangs. Exactly TWO normal human arms, TWO hands and TWO legs, anatomically correct. Render her completely as a contemporary human: no cobalt armor, blade antennae, binders, GN drives, rifle, helmet, mechanical joints or glowing sensors. Fully opaque secure workwear, no readable text, logos or watermark.
